name: gabion-gossip-visualizer
description: In-browser explorable explanation of gabion's gossip-based distributed rate limiter, driven by the real gossip + CRDT core compiled to WebAssembly.

scripts.build:wasm: RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=nightly RUSTFLAGS='-Copt-level=z -Zunstable-options -Cpanic=immediate-abort' wasm-pack build .. --release --target web --out-dir web/src/wasm --out-name gabion_wasm -- -Zbuild-std=std,panic_abort,core,alloc
scripts.build: pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm run check && vite build
